question: By whom are these rites to be performed?
premises: rites are to be performed always
they are performed by woman or man
sa is joined with six longs
inference: These rites are to be performed always, by woman or man, with sa joined with six longs, limbs and faces.
plain_english: These are to be performed always, O goddess, by woman or man, with sa joined with six longs, limbs and faces.
